TipSearchSession: Filter by process or session name
HintPlaying: Apps with an active audio session appear here. Pick an output device, set volume, then Apply to reroute and persist.
HintNoSessions: No audio sessions detected. Play a sound in an app and it will show up here.
HintRoutes: Persistent routes: matched apps are routed automatically on launch (within 2–4 s).
TipReapply: Reapply routes to currently running matched processes
HintLive: Live routes held by the Coordinator. Break only tears down the active link and keeps the route record (still applies on next launch); remove records on the Routes page.
HintNoLive: No live links (they appear once a route is applied).
CheckStartWithWindows: Start with Windows (runs at sign-in; writes to the current user's Run key)
CheckOsd: Show OSD hints (on-screen popup when switching devices / adjusting volume)
CheckDefaultAutoRefresh: Enable auto-refresh when the window opens
HintHotkeyFormat: Format: Ctrl+Alt+arrow/letter; empty = disabled. Click Apply Hotkeys to take effect.
HintConfigPath: Config is stored at %APPDATA%\PerAppAudio\ui.json; see the Tools menu for the log and route files.
TipRowClick: Click a row to cycle its output device
MsgAlreadyRunning: PerAppAudio is already running (single instance). Check the system tray icon.
AboutIntro: Per-app audio output routing — send each app's audio to a different output device.
AboutMethodADesc: 30–60 ms, driver-free, reroutes currently playing streams
AboutMethodBDesc: Driver-free and injection-free; persists a per-app default output that applies on app start
AboutStrategy: Default auto strategy: B first, falling back to A within 2 s.
AboutLicense: MIT License · fully local, zero network requests, no telemetry
UsageDetectDesc: lists apps with an active audio session (play a sound once and it appears)
UsageOneClickDesc: pick an output device → Apply: reroutes immediately and writes a persistent route
UsageAutoRefreshDesc: off by default; enable when needed (10 s interval), or click Refresh anytime
UsagePersistDesc: matched apps are routed on launch (within 2–4 s) and survive reboots
UsageModeDesc: Auto / A live / B persist; changes apply to running processes immediately
UsageProfileDesc: define profiles in rules.yaml, switch from the header or the tray
UsageLogDesc: every action and failure is recorded on the Log page; open the log file from the Tools menu
SpMicHint: The current mode needs a virtual microphone device, but none was found (install VoiceMeeter / VB-CABLE or similar virtual audio device). This mode is unavailable for now.
SpHotkeyPrompt: Press a key combo for "{0}" (e.g. Ctrl+Alt+1):
SpHotkeyHint: Supports Ctrl/Alt/Shift/Win + letter/digit/arrow/F1-F12. Leave empty to unbind.
SpHint: Drop wav/mp3 files into the sounds folder and buttons appear automatically; click to play, click again to stop, and multiple can play at once. Right-click a button to set a hotkey / enable loop. Pick a mode at the top; the mic mode needs a virtual audio device (e.g. VoiceMeeter, VB-CABLE). Volume applies to the next playback.
SpEmpty: The sounds folder is empty — click "Sounds Folder" to add wav/mp3 files.
SpBlockVoice: Block voice (sound only, no mic forward)
SpMixMic: Mix in mic (capture real mic too)
HintSoundpadHotkeys: Same format as global hotkeys; empty = disabled. Click "Apply soundboard hotkeys". Index hotkeys: Alt+digit / Ctrl+Alt+digit play the Nth sound.
SpIndexHotkeys: Enable index hotkeys (Alt / Ctrl+Alt + digit plays Nth)
SpEditorHint: Drag the two sliders to set the kept region, then export into the sounds folder.
SpEditorPreviewing: Previewing… (click Preview again to switch; closes automatically on window close)
